title: At 1024 px the part window footer fits and below md its buttons go full width
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. (Delete permission, so Delete Part shows.) Data: QAPL-T1. Light theme. Window sizes 1024 px, then 375 px (below md), then 1366 px.
custom_steps:
1. Set the window to 1024 px > Parts > Inventory > open QAPL-T1.
  2. Scroll to the bottom of the dialog and look at the footer.
  3. Resize to 375 px with the dialog open.
  4. Click Cancel.
  5. Resize to 1366 px and open QAPL-T1 again.
custom_expected:
1. "Edit Inventory Part" opens.
  2. A thin line sits above the footer; Delete Part at the left, Cancel and Save at the right, all on one row inside the dialog, nothing overflowing or clipped.
  3. Each footer button spans the full width, stacked, Delete Part first.
  4. The dialog closes without saving.
  5. The footer is back on one row: Delete Part left, Cancel and Save right.
